metadata.description: Spec-driven code generation plugins for Augentic.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Skills for the Specify workflow: `/spec:init` scaffolds a project, `/spec:plan` authors the change-level plan, `/spec:execute` confirms Gate 1 and drives the drained execute loop, the per-slice breakouts (`/spec:refine`, `/spec:build`, `/spec:merge`, `/spec:drop`) drive one slice at a time, and `/spec:finalize` closes the change.
